blurb: If you are reading this you are likely a card carrying AA member! Good for you, welcome to the club! If you don’t have a card yet, get your ass to Arkane Aleworks and ask for one before ordering your next beer! This card entitles you to a bunch of amazing Arkane schwag and benefits only available by completing cards and unlocking perks. How do you get these perks?
